description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - The award made for Industrial Dispute between Mr. P. H. C. Peiris & 494 employees and the Lanka Sathosa Limited. (E  only)
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award related to an industrial dispute under the Industrial Disputes Act. It involves legal proceedings, regulatory compliance, and the application of labor laws, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory category (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized administrative categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
